message: Can you look at this ECG? I think it's normal, right?
reply:
**I would not call this ECG normal.** It shows a very regular, fast rhythm—about **150–160 beats/minute**—with abnormal, apparently widened electrical complexes and a leftward electrical axis.

This is concerning for a **wide-complex tachycardia**. Ventricular tachycardia is one possibility; a rhythm arising in the upper chambers with abnormal conduction is another. I can’t reliably distinguish these from this image alone, and this needs urgent clinical assessment. [American Heart Association guidance](https://www.heart.org/-/media/CPR-Files/CPR-Guidelines-Files/2025-Algorithms/Algorithm-ACLS-Tachycardia-250514.pdf)

**If this ECG reflects your rhythm now, seek emergency care now, even if you feel reasonably well.** If you have chest pain, breathlessness, dizziness, fainting, or marked weakness, call emergency services and don’t drive yourself.

Was this recorded today, and are you having any symptoms?
